'''A Joint Venture''' is a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer quests|quest]] in ''[[The Witcher: Monster Slayer]]''.

==Walkthrough==
At the end of the previous quest, the player is presented with a treasure map by [[Thorstein]].

After it is read, a new quest location to investigate appears at about 1 km away from the player's current location.

At the first quest target location, a stone monolith is found, with four sides covered with runes. The game instructs how to touch the sides in the correct order, though the game is safely railroaded and brute-forcing the order is fine.

The player learns that a Gargoyle King must be brought a gift befitting of royalty. A map below the monolith shows three possible targets which appear on the map: a '''sword''', a '''crown''' and a '''heart'''. These targets are guarded by easy undead opponents that appear when the map item is selected, without the option to prepare.

At the first one (or at the sword), the Gargoyle King's statue and an offering bowl can be found. It can be offered wrong things for thoroughness and entertainment. The one the king expects is the stone heart, which much be discovered on the map before it can be offered to the bowl.

After a successful offering, the Gargoyle King is pleased and agrees to fight you. On the first fight, there is no option to prepare, but if you need to try again you can use [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|oils]], [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potions]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|bombs]] as usual.

Once the [[gargoyle]] is defeated, a pedestal with an elven figurine thrusts up from the ground.

To tie the quest to the next, [[Thorstein]] proposes to bring it to a scholar who might be interested in such elven handicrafts, located in [[Dol Tirthana]].

[[Liho]] |starting_icon = }} '''Evil Never Sleeps''' ia a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== The quest begins with talking to [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Bedwyr]], who commissions you to get rid of [[arachnomorph]]s. During slaying the monsters you rescue a local river port captain - [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Maredudd]]. After killing the [[arachnomorph]]s, [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Maredudd]] thanks you for help and later you are delivered gold by [[Dehael]]. After returning to [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Bedwyr]] for the proper payment, you receive a mysterious amulet. It turns out it's cursed, and it makes every creature you come across look like a [[liho]]. [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Bedwyr]] shares his [[Boduen de Kurtene's journal|diary]], which contains tips on how to get rid of the curse. In order to break it, you need to collect '''leshen moss''' and '''cowbane''', light a bonfire and then, cast the ingredients and the amulet into it. The leshen moss is obtained by killing a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|leshen hound]], it's better to prepare before the fight by using a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|relict oil]] or a booster [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potion]]. The cowbane can be picked in a location marked on the map. After assembling all ingredients and performing the ritual, a real [[liho]] appears. It's a pretty strong opponent, so it's recommended to use a combinaion of [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|relict oil]], [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potions]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|bombs]] to defeat it. After killing the monster, dispose of the amulet at least 1000 m from the site of performing the ritual, so that the curse doesn't return. You can also throw it out anywhere, but the curse will not break properly. Afterwards, go to [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Bedwyr]] for payment, you can take the money and leave or insult him for deceiving you. == Journal entry == : ''Met a man named Bedwyr of Ewigbrid, who hired me to deal with some arachnomorphs that had infested the edge of a nearby forest. He must've been losing plenty of sleep over these monsters because he looked like he was on his last legs.'' : ''THE WITCHER CAME UPON A NEST OF ARACHNOMORPHS, AND IN IT - BESIDES TWO MONSTERS WAS A LONGISH COCOON SMOTHERED IN SPIDERWEBS.'' : ''WHEN THE COCOON STARTED TO SQUIRM VIOLENTLY AND EMIT STRANGE, MUFFLED NOISES, THE WITCHER BOLDLY UNSHEATHED HIS/HER SWORD AND ATTACKED.'' : ''I killed the arachnomorphs and managed to save Maredudd - the captain of the local river port - while I was at it.'' : ''Turned out the contract was a ruse. That amulet Bedwyr gave me as thanks for my help? Cursed. And this curse can only be passed on to someone with no knowledge of it. Apparently, it could be undone - but you'd need a witcher to do it. The information I need will be in the journal of that scholar who was investigating the curse.'' : ''I read the journal. The curse's symptoms manifest as extreme exhaustion and visual and auditory hallucinations, among others. To break it, I need to defeat the liho trapped inside the amulet. Throwing the amulet into a fire along with a mixture of leshen moss and cowbane should lure the monster out.'' : ''I prepared a mixture ecessary ingredients. I'm hoping the journal's instructions are effective because these hallucinations are not making my job any easier.'' : ''It worked. I beat the liho. Now, there's a decision to make - save time and toss the amulet somewhere near where I defeated the monster against the scholar's advice? Or, avoid risking the curse's return and dump it at least a thousand paces away from the site?'' : '''If the amulet is discarded in a remote place''' :: ''I decided to play it safe, and according to the instructions, threw the amulet far from where I beat the liho. A real reward this time.'' : '''The good ending cutscene''' :: ''FOR THE FIRST TIME IN A LONG, LONG TIME, BEDWYR FELT LIKE HIMSELF, LIKE HE COULD BREATHE EASY. THANKS TO THE WITCHER, NO ONE WOULD FALL VICTIM TO THE CURSED AMULET EVER AGAIN.'' [[pl:Licho nadało]] [[uk:Зло ніколи не спить]] [[Category:The Witcher Monster Slayer quests]]

These creatures are 1 skull creatures and therefor pretty strong for beginners. Fortunately as a tutorial you get the much needed bombs, [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|oils]], and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potions]] to win this battle with relative ease. You must find [[Margit (scholar)|Margit]], a scholar who is supposed to help identify the elven statue. [[Margit (scholar)|Margit]] buys the artifact and then smashes it into pieces. They don't pose much challange, but you can use [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|insectoid oil]] or [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|bombs]] if necessary. After the monsters are slain, the witcher finds [[Dehael]] in one of the cocoons. The fetus can only be obtained in the second location, after defeating mid level [[endrega warrior]]s. [[Archespore]] (optional) |starting_icon = }} '''Intruder''' is the final quest in {{TWMS}}. It ends the first season of quests. It is a direct continuation of ''[[The Great Mushrooming]]'' quest. ==Walkthrough== This quest is unlocked after ''[[The Great Mushrooming]]'' and ''[[Sins of our Fathers]]'' are completed. It begins with a message brought by [[Dehael]]. Mayor [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Goronwy]] calls you for an urgent meeting. The mayor informs you that a local family of farmers has been killed by a monster. Go to the marked location and examine the crime scene. It turns out that the killer is the [[frightener]]. After the investigation, the monster appears and the fight begins. The [[frightener]] is a very tough opponent - an extreme level legendary [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|monster]]. It's vulnerable to silver and strong attacks, so use of a good [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|silver sword]] (like ''Melltith, Ursine or Griffin'' swords), more than 1 booster [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potion]] (like ''Thunderbolt, Cat, Petri's Philter, Swift''), [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|insectoid oil]] and preparing a few ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|Moon Dust]]'' bombs is advised. * '''The frightener is slain''' - You find a pin on the monster's body, which you decide to show to the mayor. Before talking to [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Goronwy]], a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|masked sorcerer]] appears. He orders you to return the pin. You can ask him questions, but he will not answer any. It doesn't matter whether you agree to return the pin or not: in the first case, the sorcerer takes it and disappears, in the second case, he stuns the witcher, takes the pin and disappears. * '''The frightener wins''' - [[Thorstein]] suggests asking [[Vesemir]] for advice. The [[witcher]] offers you an antidote for the [[frightener]] venom, but the potion requires collecting '''archespore sap'''. While looking for an [[archespore]] to slay, you meet [[Dehael]]. The boy asks many questions about being a [[witcher]]. You can advise him what to do in case of encountering a monster or dismiss him. How you handle talking to [[Dehael]] may influence later stages of the quest. After obtaining the [[archespore]] sap, a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|masked sorcerer]] appears. He offers you gold in exchange for waiting 24 hours with killing the [[frightener]]. If the offer is refused, he disappears. If accepted, he orders you to return for the gold tomorrow. To fight the [[frightener]] again, follow the marker and use the antidote before the fight. The quest has three endings: * '''Refusing the sorcerer''' - the village remains intact, [[Dehael]] gives you the ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|Dehael's Pride]]'' trinket. * '''Deal with the sorcerer, ignoring Dehael''' - after 24 hours, the village is destroyed, you find [[Dehael]]'s body, and the sorcerer pays for the contract. You receive a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|bloody sword]] trinket. * '''Deal with the sorcerer, advicing Dehael''' - after 24 hours, the village is destroyed, but you don't find [[Dehael]]'s body, and the sorcerer pays for the contract. In the last 2 variants, you can also track down and kill the [[frightener]], and then return to the surviving mayor for the reward. You will receive 50 coins. == Journal entry == : ''The mayor promised he'd send someone to me about a contract on the frightener.'' : ''Goronwy wanted to hire me to kill the frightener, which had already slaughtered a family of farmers. I decided to make my way to the farm and take a look around.'' : ''The mayor wasn't exaggerating. At the farm, we were met with a truly grisly sight - bodies strewn across the road, and blood running down the walls. The tracks - feet and an abdomen imprinted in the mud - made it obvious a frightener was responsible for the massacre. I followed its trail.'' : ''AS THEY NEARED THE FARMHOUSE, THORSTEIN REGRETTED HIS HEARTY BREAKFAST. THE SIGHT OF THE GRISLY SCENE PAINTED IN RED BEFORE THEIR EYES THREATENED TO CALL THAT BREAKFAST BACK UP HIS GULLET.'' : ''THE WITCHER BEGAN TO EXAMINE THE BODIES. [[Nekker Shaman]] (optional) |starting_icon = }} '''Monster Slayer''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== Starting the quest can be a bit tricky. You must kill at least 1 rock [[troll]], then lose to the next one you encounter several times until the [[troll]] talks. It's not specified how many [[troll]]s you have to kill, or how many times you have to lose to the [[troll]] before it talks. Trolls are mid level mosnters and can be quite challenging, so it's better to prepare for the fight with an [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|ogroid oil]], booster [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potions]] and a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|steel sword]] of choice. The [[troll]] introduces himself as [[Grub]] and offers you a contract to find the killer of his cousins. [[Grub]] guides you to the crime scene. After inspecting the dead [[troll]], you need to decide who is to blame: * The bandits - [[Grub]] will guess that they are not capable of killing a [[troll]] and will attack you. * The [[Nekker Shaman]] - [[Grub]] will consider this plausible and offer payment: gray or yellow stones. Gray stones are a useless quest item, while yellow stones are in fact gold coins. * Attacking the [[troll]] - if you win, you get experience points, if you lose, the quest ends. The journal entry varies depending on the ending. It's easy to end this quest by angering [[Grub]] while talking to him for the first time or by killing other [[troll]]s while the quest is active. In both cases, the [[troll]] attacks. == Journal entry == : ''The life of a witcher is full of surprises. One day, a troll blocked my path - but not to kill me. "Somebody" (me) had killed his cousin and some other trolls. So, this one, Grub, wanted to hire me. And that's the story of how I took a contract to hunt and kill myself.'' : '''If bandits are blamed''' :: ''I tried to put the blame on bandits, but Grub turned out to be smarter than his thick skull let on. He attacked me and left me no choice.'' :: '''If Grub is killed''' ::: ''He joined his cousin in the ground.'' : '''If the nekker shaman is blamed''' :: ''I put the blame on a nekker shaman because I knew such creatures were easy pickings around here. My story was as thin as a cyclops thigh was thick, but Grub believed every word.'' :: '''Choosing gold''' ::: ''I received gold as a reward.'' [[Archespore]] |starting_icon = }} '''Sins of our Fathers''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== The quest begins by finding an unconscious [[witcher]]. It turns out that he intentionally put himself into hibernation. A note found next to him orders you to bring him to the local herbalist, [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Varik]]. [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Varik]] orders you to collect the ingredients needed for the antidote - '''drowner's saliva''' and '''mugwort'''. The herbalist gives the player character a potion that is supposed to make the body immune to toxins, but also has a negative effect on the stats. After drinking the potion, you have '''2 hours''' to find the ingredients. During the quest, you must kill a [[drowner]] for its saliva and a [[giant centipede]] guarding the location of the mugwort. These monsters aren't too demanding, but you can make the fight easier by using a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|necrophage]] or [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|insectoid oil]] and a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|silver sword]]. After receiving the ingredients, [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Varik]] prepares the antidote and orders you to wait until tomorrow, when the mysterious [[witcher]] wakes up. After visiting the herbalist again, the [[witcher]] introduces himself as [[Vesemir]] and offers you to fulfill a [[Sins of our Fathers|certain contract]] insted of him. [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Varik]] gives you an antidote for the anti-toxin potion. After completing the quest, you receive the ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|Brother in Arms]]'' trinket. == Journal entry == : ''While Thorstein and I were exploring Dol Tirthana, we stumbled upon a witcher kneeling on the ground. It seemed he'd self-induced hibernation. I thought I'd seen him around Kaer Morhen, but I couldn't put my finger on his name. The wound on his arm, though ugly, could not be the cause of his current state. Beside him lay a small note: "Bring me to Varik the herbalist. Tell him he was right."'' : ''I carried the unconscious witcher to the herbalist, Varik. The man, who turned out to be as eccentric as he was grumpy, revealed that my colleague had ignored his advice and stubbornly decided to walk through some highly poisonous plants without a protective decoction. I promised to find the ingredients for an antidote.'' : ''I was able to collect the drowner's saliva and mistle root. The herbalist told me to visit the witcher the next day. {{Infobox Quest3 |type = |name = Sins of our Fathers |image = twms_quest_icon_sins.png |region = [[Dol Tirthana]] |level = |previous = [[Pride Ain't Cheap]] |next = [[The Great Mushrooming]] |reward = [[File:twms_currency_gold_coin.png|15px]]60 (v1.1)

750 XP (v1.1)
[[The Witcher Monster Slayer armor|Hermit's Armor]] |enemies = [[Arachas]]
[[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|Vodnik]]
[[White Striga]] |starting_icon = }} '''Sins of our Fathers''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. It unlocks after completing ''[[Pride Ain't Cheap]]''. ==Walkthrough== This quest is started by talking to [[Vesemir]] after completing ''[[Pride Ain't Cheap]]'' quest. [[Vesemir]] orders you to go to the client, a hermit, to verify the contract. He also gives you his [[Vesemir's notes|journal]], containing information about the [[White Striga|striga]]. In the marked location, you meet the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|hermit]] fighting an [[arachas]], you need to help him by killing the monster. The [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|hermit]] confirms the contract. You can tell him about the option to lift the curse from the [[White Striga|striga]]. To lift the curse, you need '''vodnik's blood''' and '''candles'''. A [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|vodnik]] can be found somewhere in the area, and candles are provided by [[Thorstein]]. He suggests buying them for 60 coins, but he doesn't charge anything. * Killing the [[White Striga|striga]] - go to the indicated location and fight the monster. Then go to the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|hermit]] for a reward. You will receive gold coins and a ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|broken sword]]'' trinket. : The striga is pretty difficult to kill, since it's an extreme level legendary monster - a [[White Striga]]. Recommended items to use in the fight are: booster [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|potions]] like ''Thunderbolt'', ''Cat'' or ''Swift'', a couple of ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|Moon Dust]]'' bombs, a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|cursed ones oil]] and a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|good silver sword]] like ''Melltith'', ''Manticore'' or ''Griffin'' sword. * Disenchanting the [[striga]] - go to the indicated location '''at night''' and perform the ritual - pour blood on the grave and light the candles. Burning 1 candle takes 15 mins in v1.1 and 10 mins in v1.2. After all 3 candles have burned out, the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|hermit]] appears thanking you for disenchanting his daughter. As a reward, you receive the ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer armor|Hermit's Armor]]'', 60 coins and the ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|Something More]]'' trinket - three burned out candles. == Journal entry == : ''Vesemir gave me the details of the contract I'd accepted. It involves the disposing of a striga - or breaking her curse. Depends on what I decide to do.'' : ''Vesemir told me the person who'd offered him the job was a hermit, so I was expecting someone more... anemic. Meanwhile, here was this big, brawny warrior fighting an arachas, the two going head to head, nearly evenly matched. I gave him a hand. After the fight, I officially accepted the contract.'' : '''If the hermit is told about the possibility of lifting the curse''' :: ''Against Vesemir's advice, I mentioned to the hermit that I could break the curse. I hoped this wouldn't bite me in the ass later.'' : ''WHEN THE WITCHER AND THORSTEIN ARRIVED AT THE HUT. THEY SPOTTED A BIG, BURLY MAN FIGHTING AN ARACHAS. HIS MOVES BELIED UNCOMMON SKILL FOR A HUMAN AT LEAST.'' : ''THOUGH THE MAN SEEMED TO BE FARING WELL ENOUGH ON HIS OWN. THE WITCHER PREFERRED NOT TO TAKE ANY CHANCES - HE/SHE PROMPTLY RUSHED INTO FIGHT.'' : '''If the curse is lifted''' :: ''Spending a night in that musty crypt was... unpleasant, to say the least, but I was able to break the striga's curse. The hermit gave me his old armor in thanks. Nice bit of equipment.'' :: ''THE WITCHER SURVEYED THE BONES, PICKED CLEAN AND STREWN HAPHAZARDLY ON THE GROUND BEFORE THE CRYPT. THEN, HE/SHE STEPPED INSIDE AND BLOCKADED THE DOOR.'' :: ''AS THE RITUAL INDICATED, HE/SHE LIT THE FIRST CANDLE AND BEGAN THE INCANTATION. ALL THAT COULD BE HEARD WAS HIS/HER STEADY VOICE - AND THE DISTANT HOWLS OF THE STRIGA.'' :: ''THE CURSE NOW LIFTED. THE GIRL LOOKED FIT AND HEALTHY, BUT SOMETHING IN HER MOUEMENTS RECALLED THE WILD THING SHE'D BEEN.'' :: ''MANY HARDSHIPS AWAITED THE HERMIT AND HIS LONG-LOST DAUGHTER ON THE ROAD AHEAD. BUT THANKS TO THE WITCHER, THEIR FUTURE WAS NOW SHINING BRIGHTER THAN BEFORE.'' : '''If the striga is killed''' :: ''THE WITCHER SLAYED THE STRIGA. IT TURNED OUT THAT VESEMIR WAS INDEED RIGHT TO WARN HIM/HER AGAINST IGNITING THE HERMIT'S HOPES. SURPRISED BY HIS ATTACK, THE WITCHER WAS UNABLE TO DEFEAT THE GRIEF-CRAZED MAN AND HAD TO DEPART WITHOUT HIS/HER COIN.'' ::''SOMETIME LATER, THE NEIGHBORING VILLAGE'S INHABITANTS FOUND HIS ABANDONED HUT. NO ONE COULD SAY FOR SURE WHAT HAD HAPPENED TO THE HERMIT WHO ONCE LIVED THERE.'' ==Notes== * If you're going to disenchant the [[White Striga]], it's essential to arrive at the graveyard '''at night''', otherwise the creature will spawn too early and you'll be forced to kill it instead. * The disenchanting ritual can take from 45 to 30 minutes, depending on the game version. ==Gallery== TWMS_Hermits_Armor_Male.png|''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer armor|The Hermit's Armor]]'', a reward for disenchanting the girl twms_icon_trophy_used_candles.png|''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|Something more]]'' - a trinket received after completing the ritual twms_icon_trophy_broken_sword.png|[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|A broken sword]] trinket, received after killing the [[White Striga|striga]] [[pl:Grzechy naszych ojców]] [[uk:Гріхи наших батьків]] [[Category:The Witcher Monster Slayer quests]]

Sword in the Stone.wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest3 |type = |name = Sword in the Stone |image = twms_quest_icon_sword.png |region = [[Dol Tirthana]] |level = |previous = [[The Dark Side of the Full Moon]] |next = |reward = 150 XP (v1.1)
165 XP (v1.2)
[[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|Dawnbringer]] |enemies = Stone [[golem]] |starting_icon = }} '''Sword in the Stone''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== The quest is started by: * buying a map from [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]] for 500 coins * getting a map after sparing [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]] in ''[[The Dark Side of the Full Moon]]'' quest * finding the map after killing/chasing away [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]] in ''[[The Dark Side of the Full Moon]]'' quest After looking at the map, go to the marked location. [[Thorstein]] helps you read the inscription: you must come to the sword at dusk to learn its name. The game has a built-in clock showing the beginning of the times of the day, which you need to pay attention to in the next stage. Upon returning at dusk, you can read the name of the sword - ''Dawnbringer''. In order to draw the sword, you need to return at dawn, as indicated by the in-game clock. At dawn, you speak the name and the ''Guardian of the Sword'' - a stone [[golem]], appears. The [[golem]] is a mid level monster, so using [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|Dimeritium bomb]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|elemental oil]] is a good idea. After defeating the guardian, you receive the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|sword]] as a trophy. == Journal entry == : ''I received a map from Lothar. He told me it'd lead me to a treasure, so I thought I should investigate.'' : ''I found a sword that was somehow trapped in a large boulder. No amount of human - or witcher-strength could pull it from the stone. However, Thorstein and I deduced that at sunset, the sword's name would appear and that we should speak the name at sunrise.'' : ''When I returned to the stone at dusk, I saw that some of the inscription letters were glowing. They spelled out the sword's name - Deitmenae. Dawnbringer.'' : ''At dawn I spoke the name. Wasn't too surprised when the rock turned out to be a dormant golem. I defeated it and took the sword, a nice piece of quality eleven steel.'' ==Notes== * Different quest stages can be completed on different days, for example: you visit the location at dusk and return in 3 days at dawn. * You can repeat the golem stage as many times as it takes for you to succeed. The Dark Side of the Full Moon.wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest3 |type = |name = The Dark Side of the Full Moon |image = twms_quest_icon_moon.png |region = [[Dol Tirthana]] |level = |previous = |next = |reward = 350 XP (v1.1)
Map (optional) |enemies = [[Werewolf]] |starting_icon = }} '''The Dark Side of the Full Moon''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== The quest can only be started during a full moon. Go to the blacksmith's forge at night, where you find claw marks. You need to follow the monster's trail and save [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]]. After reaching the place where the tracks lead, it turns out that the blacksmith himself is a [[werewolf]]. If you talk to him, he reveals a handful of information about the nature of his curse. * Sparing the [[werewolf]] - [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]] will return to his forge after the full moon, and as a reward, he will give you a map to the location of a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|unique sword]]. * Killing/chasing away the [[werewolf]] - [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]] is replaced by a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|dwarven blacksmith]] offering the same services. : In order to withstand the fight, you need to prepare accordingly by using a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|cursed one oil]], potions like ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|Thunderblot]]'' and ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|Cat]]'' or a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|''Moon Dust'' bomb]]. It's better to use a good [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|silver sword]], since the [[werewolf]] is a strong opponent. After completing the quest, you will receive the ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|The Werewolf's Lot]]'' trinket and ''[[Lothar's notes]]''. == Journal entry == : ''The smithy was suspiciously empty when I stopped by. The anvil was still radiating warmth, and I spotted werewolf prints nearby. Noting that the moon was full, I decided to investigate this lead and followed the tracks.'' : '''If Lothar is spared''' :: ''The werewolf turned out to be the blacksmith. He promised me that he could control the beast within, thanks to an infusion of wolfsbane. I believed him and let him go free.'' :: ''THE WITCHER DECIDED THAT LOTHAR POSED NO REAL DANGER AND SET HIM FREE. THOUGH THE BLACKSMITH'S FATE WAS HARDLY ENVIABLE, THE MAN DID HIS BEST TO LIVE WITH HUMAN DIGNITY. PROVING WEREWOLVES DIDN'T ALWAYS SUCCUMB TO THE BEAST WITHIN.'' :: ''Lothar thanked me with a treasure map. I offered to help him lift the curse, but he wasn't interested - apparently, it had already been tried. The secret of his lycanthropy would stay between us.'' ==Notes== * This quest must be started and completed during a '''full moon''', at '''night time'''. If you wait or linger till dawn, you get a message that the trail is lost and the quest will fail. * It is possible to complete the quest the night '''after''' it starts, but it still has to be a full moon. * If [[Lothar (blacksmith)|Lothar]] is spared, one slot in the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|glossary]] will remain blank, since it's intended for the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|new blacksmith]]. [[Fiend]] |starting_icon = }} '''The Great Mushrooming''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== The quest is started by talking to an [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|eccentric man]]. He informs you about a mushroom picking competition and gives you the key to a treasure chest. After finding the treasure, go to mayor [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Goronwy]], who organizes ''The Great Mushrooming''. He explains the rules - whoever collects the most mushrooms within '''24 hours''', wins. You can sign up immediately, which starts the timer, or say you're not ready and continue the quest later. After the counter starts, mushroom markers start to appear on the map. Each of them spawns 1 to 7 mushrooms. They don't go in your inventory, so there's no limit of how much you can collect. During this stage you shouldn't mark another quest as '''active''' or mushrooms will '''stop generating'''. When the game displays a message: ''All right. Mushrooms are bursting from the basket. Should be enough'', it means that you should score the 1st place. In order to win you should allegedly have over 150 mushrooms. While picking mushrooms, you will come across 4 random encounters: a mushroom picker rescue, a dead [[cyclops]], a chat with [[Dehael]], and killing [[draconid]]s. * A mushroom picker rescue - A woman has climed a tree to flee from [[nekker]]s. You can either steal her mushrooms and leave her, or kill the [[nekker]]s. Grateful [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Emlyn]] will tell you where to find more mushrooms. However, the mushroom spot is taken by a [[leshen]], which you have to defeat. * A dead [[cyclops]] - you stumble upon its body, the playable character says that it was killed by a [[frightener]] and the locals should be warned. * A chat with [[Dehael]] - the boy has many questions, if you answers all of them, he will show you a good mushrooming spot. * Draconids - you find a human hand, it's near a nemeton with [[draconid]]s. You get 50 coins for clearing the spot. After 24 hours have passed, return to the mayor. During the award ceremony, a [[fiend]] appears and you need to take care of it. Then the mayor grants you a prize adequate to the amount of picked mushrooms - a ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|mushroom statue]]'' trinket, and for killing the [[fiend]] - the ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|Mushroom Sentinel]]'' trinket. At the end, you warn the mayor about the [[frightener]]. == Journal entry == : ''Looking around for work, I ran into a very strange man on the road who seemed to be waiting for me. Muttering something about how I was "gonna do just fine" (in what?), he urged me to take part in the Great Mushrooming (the what?!). Somewhere in his crazed mumblings, I heard him tell me where I would find something I was looking for. That sounded worth looking into, at least.'' : ''Sure enough, there was a chest where he'd told me to go and the key I'd found earlier fit. The strange man's advice, it seemed, had gotten me this far, so I decided to take part in this "Great Mushrooming." : ''I introduced myself to the mayor of Darach Dearg and officially became a mushroomer. The competition would last twenty-four hours, so I set off to hunt for mushrooms hoping to earn the winner's purse.'' : ''During the competition, I ran into a rival who'd run up a tree to escape some nekkers. Her mushroom basket lay on the ground nearby.'' : '''If Emlyn is saved''' :: ''Would've been easy to nab it and go, but I decided to help her out. In thanks, Emlyn, as she was called, told me where I could find a huge patch of porcinis. However, she warned me that it was also the territory of a leshen.'' : ''TEARING THROUGH THE WOODS, THE WITCHER HEARD SOMEONE CALLING FOR HELP. WHEN HE/SHE ARRIVED ON THE SCENE, HE/SHE NEARLY TRIPPED ON AN OVERTURNED BASKET OF MUSHROOMS.'' : ''ITS OWNER WAS SITTING IN AN OLD OAK, BENEATH WHICH WERE TWO NEKKERS INTENT ON REACHING HER. PREOCCUPIED WITH THE MONSTERS, THE WOMAN DIDN'T NOTICE THE WITCHER STANDING NEARBY.'' : ''This forest was full of surprises - like this cyclops corpse. After a quick inspection, I concluded that the giant had been killed by a frightener. The locals were in for some real trouble if such a dangerous insectoid was prowling the area.'' : ''Sometime later I crossed paths with Dehael. Talkative little snot was on an errand, but as usual, he had time to ask me a long list of questions.'' : '''If Dehael is ignored''' :: ''I didn't have time to chat, however.'' : ''Besides the frightener, some draconids were wreaking havoc in the forest. The only remnant of their latest victim was a chewed-off arm. I tracked the monsters and killed them.'' : ''After twenty-four hours, the Great Mushrooming was over. A raging fiend interrupted the awards ceremony. Good thing I was there to help, otherwise the day would've ended in tragedy.'' : '''If the main prize is won''' :: ''I killed the fiend, and I won the title of Champion Mushroomer! Not only did I earn a trophy and "eternal glory," but, most importantly, I took home a fat winner's purse.'' : ''Before I left, I told the mayor about the frightener tracks I'd come across earlier. He promised he would soon have someone summon me to discuss the matter with him further.'' : ''THE AWARDS CEREMONY HAD BARELY BEGUN WHEN SUDDENLY. A RABID, RAGING FIEND STORMED INTO THE CROWD. IT WAS ITS UNLUCKY DAY, HOWEVER, GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF A CERTAIN WITCHER AT THAT VERY CEREMONY...'' ==Gallery== twms_icon_trophy_mushroom_trophy_1.png|''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|The Champion]]'' trophy twms_icon_trophy_mushroom_sentinel.png|''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer trinkets|Mushroom Sentinel]]'', a trinket for killing the [[fiend]] [[de:Die große Pilzsuche]] [[pl:Wielkie Grzybobranie]] [[uk:Великий збір грибів]] [[Category:The Witcher Monster Slayer quests]]

He claims that his wife has fallen into a deep pit and is asking for help. On the spot, instead of a woman, you find a [[devourer]]. It's a bit stronger than the one from the tutorial, so it's recommended to use [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|necrophage oil]], [[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|Thunderbolt]] or other stats boosting potion and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|bombs]]. After slaying the monster, [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Kienan]] asks for mercy, you can spare his life in exchange for a reward or kill him. If you let him go, he gives you the key to a treasure chest marked on the map. Killing [[The Witcher Monster Slayer glossary|Kienan]] also grants you a key, but you cannot discover the location of the chest and you can't get the reward. == Journal entry == : ''A man named Kienan stopped me on the road. 250 XP (v1.1) |enemies = |starting_icon = }} '''What Lurks In the Nemeta''' is a quest in {{TWMS}}. ==Walkthrough== This quest is unlocked when you reach level 10 (v1.1) or 20 (v1.2), right after clearing your first [[nemeton]]. Next to a nemeton, there's a body of a man and a [[notebook]]. It shows that the [[nemeton|nemeta]] researcher intended to meet his associate at '''Traegan Well''', '''at sunset in a few days'''. It's not specified exactly in how many days you need to meet the associate, but it's better to go to the meeting '''as soon as possible''', at sunset. After missing the deadline, the task cannot be completed. It appears that [[Margit (scholar)|Margit]] is the associate, as she's the one meeting you at the well. You can tell her why the researcher was killed or you can lie to her. She gives you gold coins as a reward. == Journal entry == : ''I cleaned out one of the nemeta I stumbled upon in Dol Tirthana and found a recently dead man nearby. I picked up his notes to try and establish what happened to him...''' : ''Rodrick's notes told me he was studying nemeta phenomena. He had a colleague who'd be waiting at the Traegan well at sunset for the next few days. I thought it'd be useful to meet him and give him the sad news.'' : '''If the witcher misses the meeting''' :: ''I missed the window during which Rodrick's colleague would've been waiting for the results. It's started by clearing a nemeton marked on the map. There are two [[foglet]]s and an [[Ignis Fatuus]]. Foglets are easy difficulty monsters, while Ignis Fatuus ia a mid one. You might want to use a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|necrophage oil]] and a ''[[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|Thunderbolt]]'' potion before the fight. Equipping a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|silver sword]] is also advised. After defeating the monsters, a [[will o' the wisp]] appears, which you have to follow to 3 marked locations. From the moment you reach the second location, you have only '''15 minutes''' to complete the task. It cannot be completed after the time runs out. There is a treasure in the last location. == Journal entry == : ''A will o' the wisp flew out of one of the nemeta and floated forward as if trying to show Thorstein and me something. [[Griffin (creature)]] |starting_icon = }} '''Winged Bandit''' is the first real [[The Witcher Monster Slayer quests|quest]] in {{TWMS}}. == Walkthrough == The player will find a yellow blob (quest target) nearby them, which turns out to be a young Skellige merchant by name of [[Thorstein]]. Dialogue follows, with limited options. Thorstein has lost his horse to a flying monster. The witcher will need to track his horse down to about 1 km distance from the starting location. Targets are marked on the map and pointed towards by a yellow arrow and question mark in the main view. Once the witcher is close enough to the target, it appears as another yellow map object to tap. It turns out to be the horse's head. Interact with the circles to find out it has been a [[Griffin (creature)|griffin]]. You are attacked by an [[alghoul]] (or two). The player is intended to lose this battle, and this is fine. Next, the [[Griffin (creature)|griffin]] must be found. It is not as far away from the current location, a brief walking distance. The player is presented with another map target. Once the [[Griffin (creature)|griffin]] is found, it has to be defeated. Quest monsters seem to generally not go away when the player loses the fight, so you have as many tries as you need. However, [[Thorstein]] gives you some [[The Witcher Monster Slayer oils|hybrid oil]] which you can prepare in addition to anything else you might want to use ([[The Witcher Monster Slayer potions|damage booster potion]], [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bombs|bombs]]) and you should be able to finish it with those. Hybrid oil is easy to come by later, and there is no need to save it even if you might be able to finish the [[Griffin (creature)|griffin]] without it. Once the quest is completed, [[Thorstein]] gives you a map for the next quest. It may be best to read it closer to home, as it will be again approximately 1 km away from the reading location. Quest relocation becomes available once you have walked far enough away from the previous location, though. == Journal entry == : ''WHEN THE WITCHER EMERGED FROM THE WOODS, HIS/HER EYES BEHELD A MOST CURIOUS SIGHT: A WILD ASSORTMENT OF PAPERS, BOOKS, BOXES AND GARMENTS LYING ON THE GROUND...'' : ''...AND SITTING IN THE MIDDLE OF IT ALL, A CLEARLY PAINED AND MUDDLED YOUNG MAN, DRESSED IN THE SKELLIGE FASHION. THE WITCHER SIGHED AND STEPPED TOWARDS HIM.'' : ''On my travels, I came across a young Skellige merchant. He'd been attacked by a flying monster that carried off his horse and his bags along with it. I decided to track it down and help Thorstein that was the merchant's name - recover his possessions.'' : ''The monster's tracks took us to the head of poor Joergen, Thorstein's horse. I inspected the site and concluded a young griffin was responsible. It couldn't lift the whole horse, so it tore off the least edible part with its beak. Suddenly, an alghoul attacked, drawn by the stench of carrion, no doubt. I wounded it, but didn't manage to kill it.'' : ''Before we parted, Thorstein gave me some hybrid oil, a useful thing when fighting griffins. Something told me that was not the last time he'd surprise me...'' : ''I finally tracked down and defeated the griffin. My abilities must have impressed Thorstein because he proposed I join him in a hunt for mysterious treasure marked on a map which he gave me to look over.'' : ''THE WITCHER MADE QUICK WORK OF THE GRIFFIN AND SOON REUNITED THE YOUNG MERCHANT WITH HIS WARES.'' : ''THORSTEIN DIDN'T THINK TWICE BEFORE OFFERING THE WITCHER A NEW ADVENTURE A HUNT FOR A MYSTERIOUS TREASURE. THE WITCHER DECIDED TO THINK ABOUT THIS PROPOSAL.'' [[ru:Крылатый разбойник]] [[pl:Skrzydlaty złodziej]] [[uk:Крилатий злодій]] [[Category:The Witcher Monster Slayer quests]]
